label: App Landing
summary: Full-stack SaaS app landing template: marketing pages, JSON-driven nav/footer, DB-backed blog, contact inbox, end-user support portal, and site-owner admin.

instructions.settings: Edit `_settings/*.json` for nav and footer without touching React. Exori overwrites these files when clients edit site chrome in the app.
instructions.sections: Each section folder may include `description.md` — the build spec for that route. Pages compose Nimbus blocks; extend static copy in `src/lib/content/applanding/`.
instructions.database: Blog posts, support tickets, and contact messages are stored in Postgres. Run `prisma migrate deploy` and `npm run db:seed` for demo content.

settings.description: Header navigation: variant, brand, links (with optional dropdown children), CTA, auth buttons, default theme.
Footer: brand, contact details, newsletter copy, link columns, copyright.
